Shared estimate max(2*block_K*(block_M+block_N)*num_stages, 4*block_M*block_N) kept under 32768-byte portability cap; e.g. 128x256x32x3 gives 2*32*384*3=73728 > cap so large N with stages will be rejected by HiGHS, steering selection toward feasible combos like 64x128 and 128x128 across stages 1-3. threads=[128] single-domain baseline to isolate tile/stage effects before testing thread alternatives post-feedback. M has 4096 so many tile rows exist; reuse proxy favors larger block_M and swizzle >1, so the next round should expand swizzle [0,4,8,16,32,64] and test a changed block_K or thread domain, then retain/reject based on measured simulator traffic and latency rather than the analytic reuse hypothesis.
